Title: Linux Taskbar Icon Setup
Content:
## Linux Taskbar Icon Requirements

On Linux (Ubuntu/GTK), Photino's SetIconFile() does NOT support .ico files. GTK requires PNG format for window icons.

### Required Files
- `favicon.ico` — Windows executable icon (already exists)
- `favicon.png` — Linux window icon (must be created from favicon.ico)

### Required .csproj Changes
The `.csproj` must include both icon files as content:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <Content Include="favicon.ico">
    <CopyToOutputDirectory>Always</CopyToOutputDirectory>
  </Content>
  <Content Include="favicon.png">
    <CopyToOutputDirectory>Always</CopyToOutputDirectory>
  </Content>
</ItemGroup>
```

### Code Behavior
Program.cs now uses `RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)` to select:
- Linux → `favicon.png`
- Windows/macOS → `favicon.ico`

### Important: .desktop File for Full Taskbar Integration
On modern Linux (especially Wayland), the taskbar icon is often determined by the .desktop file, NOT the window icon. For complete taskbar integration, a `.desktop` file should be installed at:
- `~/.local/share/applications/cyrena.desktop` (user)
- `/usr/share/applications/cyrena.desktop` (system)

Example desktop entry:
```ini
[Desktop Entry]
Name=Cyréna
Exec=/path/to/Cyrena.WebView
Icon=/path/to/favicon.png
Type=Application
Terminal=false
```

### Icon Installation Path
For proper icon theming, install PNG icons to:
- `~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/48x48/apps/cyrena.png`
- `~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/cyrena.png`

Then reference by name in .desktop: `Icon=cyrena`
